title: ISO3251:2019 official public abstract
read_scope: Official public abstract, not full standard or clauses; browser page lines46–53.
paraphrase: The public abstract describes a mass-based NV method for paint-related preparations and explains that reported NV is conditional on heating time/temperature. Retained solvent, decomposition and loss of low-mass ingredients can affect the residue. It does not establish the actual factory method, compatible formulation, compliance, recipe, default test conditions or universal cure/yield.
canonical_change_scope: Future actual method/state/conditions and supplier/formulation evidence requirement only; no ISO compliance or invented test settings asserted.
